propositions: git stash operations in the tickets worktree access a repo-global shared stack rather than worktree-local state, allowing stashes created in other worktrees to be applied in the tickets worktree
a stash created on a source branch was popped into the tickets worktree, materializing source files and leaving the index in an unmerged stranded state that blocked all ticket writes
the stash->merge->pop dance in push.py assumed only reconciler-regenerable files would be stashed, but this assumption does not hold when foreign stashes are applied
the maintained supported entrypoint (rebar tracker-maintenance) must create a backup ref before any writes, refuse when unpushed commits exist, and maintain a durable audit record

auto-heal in _recover_from_unmerged must classify and discard foreign paths (not tracked on tickets branch, not ticket-shaped) separately from actual ticket data to prevent wedging on stash race pollution

the ticket system must not be mutated by direct git operations in the tracker worktree; all mutations outside normal event-append must go through a first-class maintenance surface with an explicit break-glass override
